description: This file defines the ErrorGrain class, a component in an Orleans-based distributed system that implements various error scenarios, async methods, and logging. It includes methods for setting errors, throwing exceptions, unobserved task errors, and checking context preservation.

classes.name: ErrorGrain
classes.description: A Grain class that simulates various error conditions, logging, and delayed operations, used for testing error handling and context propagation in Orleans.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Initial activation logic for the grain, logs activation.

methods.name: SetAError
methods.description: Sets value A and throws an exception.

methods.name: GetAxBError
methods.description: Throws an exception for specified inputs.

methods.name: DelayMethod
methods.description: Logs, increments counter, and asynchronously delays.

methods.name: UnobservedErrorImmediate
methods.description: Creates a task that throws an unobserved error immediately.

methods.name: UnobservedErrorDelayed
methods.description: Creates a task that throws an error after a delay, leaving it unobserved.

methods.name: UnobservedErrorContinuation2
methods.description: Creates a task, then continues with an unobserved continuation that throws.

methods.name: UnobservedErrorContinuation3
methods.description: Creates a task, then a continuation with an error, including logging.

methods.name: UnobservedIgnoredError
methods.description: Creates a task that throws but is ignored, testing unobserved error handling.

methods.name: AddChildren
methods.description: Adds a list of child grains.

methods.name: ExecuteDelayed
methods.description: Executes a delayed task and verifies context preservation.
